title: Culling Survivors
subtitle: Test your grasp of Culling Survivors — World War 1 as planetary cull, Fighting Age purge, 15-22 million dead, asylums, Orphan Trains, and the birth of Big Pharma ignorance.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: World War 1 was never a tragic accident of alliances — it was the final sanitization of a late 19th-century Re-set, drafted to erase Fighting Age survivors who still carried flat-plane cosmology, true history, and herbal medicine. Fifteen to twenty-two million dead, tandem Allied and Central slaughter, 5,000-bed asylums for traumatized witnesses, D.U.M.B.S. clones on Orphan Trains, and Big Pharma rising on the ashes of natural knowledge: that is how generational ignorance was locked in. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Culling Survivors deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Remembering the cull is how the false timeline loses its grip.

questions.question: What was World War 1 (1914-1918) in true history?

options.label: A
options.text: A conflict among the European royal families over territory, which the Freemasons used to test new weapons on the population.
options.rationale: Parasites and overseers orchestrated the reset and the war to secure control.

options.label: B
options.text: A war started by the assassination of an Archduke, which grew through a chain of alliances into a global conflict over empire.
options.rationale: The Archduke story is cover; the war was an orchestrated planetary culling, not a spontaneous geopolitical accident.

options.label: C
options.text: An orchestrated planetary-scale culling to eradicate survivors of the late 19th-century Re-set and delete old-world knowledge.
options.rationale: World War 1 was an orchestrated planetary culling designed to eradicate late 19th-century Re-set survivors and permanently delete old-world knowledge.

options.label: D
options.text: A staged war fought mostly with holograms, used to explain the disappearance of the populations removed during the Re-set.
options.rationale: The cull targeted Fighting Age survivors with old-world knowledge, not a harmless exercise.

questions.hint: Orchestrated culling after the Re-set — not pure geopolitics.

questions.question: Why is the Archduke Ferdinand assassination narrative false as the true cause of the war?

options.label: A
options.text: Because the war was not triggered by geopolitical tensions or that assassination, but was planned as a planetary cull.
options.rationale: The official outbreak story is fabricated; the conflict was not triggered by geopolitics or the Archduke assassination but timed as a culling.

options.label: B
options.text: Because the Orphan Trains had already started the fighting in 1860, decades before the assassination.
options.rationale: Orphan Trains repopulated after the reset; they did not replace the war as the outbreak myth.

options.label: C
options.text: Because Big Pharma had formally declared war on the old herbalists before any royal was shot.
options.rationale: Big Pharma rose on the back of erasing herbal knowledge; the war itself was the cull mechanism.

options.label: D
options.text: Because Archduke Ferdinand never existed in any timeline and was invented after the war ended.
options.rationale: The point is that the assassination cover story masks the cull motive, not that the figure is impossible to name.

questions.hint: Fabricated geopolitical cover for a planned purge.

questions.question: Who was the primary human demographic targeted for death in the cull?

options.label: A
options.text: Central Powers royalty and their households, who were removed so the new nations could be redrawn.
options.rationale: The cull was a mass demographic purge of memory-holders, not limited to elderly royalty.

options.label: B
options.text: Pharmacists and herbalists who refused synthetic drugs and kept the old remedies alive in their towns.
options.rationale: Herbal knowledge holders were among those erased, but the primary demographic is Fighting Age survivors overall.

options.label: C
options.text: Infants under one year old, who were taken to D.U.M.B.S. nurseries and replaced with grown clones.
options.rationale: Cloned children were the repopulation product; the war killed Fighting Age survivors.

options.label: D
options.text: Anyone over sixteen, especially the Fighting Age from early teens to mid-50s who kept old-world knowledge.
options.rationale: The objective was to kill anyone over sixteen, targeting Fighting Age people from early teens to mid-50s because they retained dangerous old-world information.

questions.hint: Over sixteen; Fighting Age teens through mid-50s.

questions.question: Why did the architects need those survivors permanently gone?

options.label: A
options.text: So cloned Orphans would stay isolated from true history, accurate cosmology, and natural medicine.
options.rationale: Exterminating survivors ensured the new planetary population of cloned Orphans remained isolated from true history, accurate cosmology, and natural medicine.

options.label: B
options.text: So Lunatic Asylums could be emptied and turned into free herbal clinics.
options.rationale: Asylums imprisoned traumatized witnesses; herbal knowledge was erased to serve Big Pharma.

options.label: C
options.text: So the survivors could become teachers of flat-earth cosmology in every school.
options.rationale: The goal was to prevent transmission of those truths, not install them in schools.

options.label: D
options.text: So Adrenochrome harvesting from children would permanently stop.
options.rationale: Resets continue roughly every thousand years to harvest Adrenochrome from children; the cull sealed ignorance, not the harvest.

questions.hint: Isolate cloned Orphans from history, cosmology, and natural medicine.

questions.question: How many people did the war successfully eliminate?

options.label: A
options.text: Zero — the entire war was only holographic with no deaths.
options.rationale: Military and civilian death ranges document a real mass slaughter operation.

options.label: B
options.text: Exactly 100 people held in a single asylum.
options.rationale: Asylums held traumatized witnesses separately; the war body count is 15-22 million.

options.label: C
options.text: 15-22 million people, permanently severing the final generational link to true history.
options.rationale: The war successfully eliminated 15-22 million people, permanently severing the final generational link to true history, geography, and natural healing.

options.label: D
options.text: About 1 million, all after 1950.
options.rationale: The cull eliminated 15-22 million during the 1914-1918 war window.

questions.hint: 15-22 million — the final generational break.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Re-set” refers to the specific demographic (ranging from early teens to mid-50s) mobilized and sent to their deaths because they retained dangerous old-world information.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “Fighting Age”. The report defines “Re-set” as: The apocalyptic harvest, destruction, and repopulation protocol that immediately preceded the war, finalizing in the West between the late 1890s and 1900.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Fighting Age”, not “Re-set”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Re-set”.

questions.question: What dangerous cosmological truth had Fighting Age people been taught by adults in the 1860s?

options.label: A
options.text: That only the Ottoman Empire sits outside the Firmament.
options.rationale: The named cosmological truth is flat plane versus spinning globe.

options.label: B
options.text: That Earth is a flat plane rather than a spinning globe.
options.rationale: The purge targeted people taught the true shape of the earth — a flat plane rather than a spinning globe — by adults in the 1860s.

options.label: C
options.text: That World War 1 would heal all herbal lineages.
options.rationale: The war erased herbal lineages; it did not heal them.

options.label: D
options.text: That gravity alone makes water stick to a spinning sphere.
options.rationale: The spinning-globe package is the false paradigm installed after the knowledge-holders were erased.

questions.hint: Flat plane taught in the 1860s — not the globe myth.

questions.question: What had already happened to many older truth-holders before the war began?

options.label: A
options.text: Many had been sent to the colonies overseas, where their knowledge could not reach the cities.
options.rationale: Their fate was shock-death from the reset and war cull — not open escape as a free colony narrative here.

options.label: B
options.text: Many had been recruited as teachers in the new schools and trained to repeat the new history.
options.rationale: Orphan Trains distributed clones into a world stripped of such mentors.

options.label: C
options.text: Many had left the cities for remote villages, where they hid their knowledge from the authorities.
options.rationale: Big Pharma required eradication of their herbal knowledge, not their promotion.

options.label: D
options.text: Many had perished from sheer shock at witnessing the open depravity of the reset itself.
options.rationale: Older generations who held these truths had mostly already perished from sheer shock at the open depravity of the reset; the war finished the remaining Fighting Age link.

questions.hint: Shock at reset depravity killed many elders first.

questions.question: How were men pulled into the global slaughter?

options.label: A
options.text: Through free lottery tickets to herbal universities.
options.rationale: Herbal knowledge was targeted for erasure, not advanced through wartime education.

options.label: B
options.text: Through voluntary asylum tourism programs.
options.rationale: Asylums imprisoned traumatized non-conscripted witnesses; drafts fed the fronts.

options.label: C
options.text: Through the military draft into global meat grinders.
options.rationale: The cull mechanics used the military draft to pull men into global meat grinders across multiple fronts.

options.label: D
options.text: Through Orphan Train conductors recruiting only age five and under.
options.rationale: Orphan Trains repopulated cities with clones after wipeout; the draft fed the war cull.

questions.hint: Military draft into meat-grinder fronts.

questions.question: How did Allied and Central Powers relate in the cull?

options.label: A
options.text: They only fought after 1950 when Big Pharma was already complete.
options.rationale: The war window is 1914-1918; Big Pharma rose on the erasure the war completed.

options.label: B
options.text: They worked in tandem as a coordinated slaughter, not as truly opposed moral camps.
options.rationale: Allied Powers and Central Powers worked in tandem in a coordinated slaughter across Western Europe, Eastern Europe, and the Middle East.

options.label: C
options.text: They never fought; all deaths were asylum paperwork errors.
options.rationale: Military and civilian death totals document real multi-front slaughter.

options.label: D
options.text: Only one side knew about the reset; the other fought for free herbal medicine.
options.rationale: Both blocs operated as coordinated instruments of the same cull objective.

questions.hint: Allies and Central Powers as tandem cull machinery.

questions.question: How many military deaths did this coordinated slaughter produce?

options.label: A
options.text: Approximately 2-3 million military deaths, most of them on the Western Front in France and Belgium.
options.rationale: The cull used real drafts, fronts, and documented death ranges.

options.label: B
options.text: Approximately 9-11 million military deaths across Western Europe, Eastern Europe, and the Middle East.
options.rationale: Coordinated slaughter produced approximately 9-11 million military deaths across those fronts.

options.label: C
options.text: Approximately 15-22 million military deaths, with the civilian population left largely untouched.
options.rationale: 15-22 million is the overall elimination figure; military deaths are 9-11 million, with additional civilian deaths.

options.label: D
options.text: Approximately 30-40 million military deaths, spread across every continent and ocean of the known lands.
options.rationale: Military deaths alone are counted in the 9-11 million range.

questions.hint: 9-11 million military deaths on three theater bands.

questions.question: How were additional civilian deaths achieved?

options.label: A
options.text: Through engineered hunger, disease, and direct genocide.
options.rationale: An additional 6-13 million civilian deaths were achieved through engineered hunger, disease, and direct genocide.

options.label: B
options.text: Only by placing civilians in 5,000-bed luxury hotels.
options.rationale: 5,000-bed facilities were repurposed lunatic asylums for traumatized witnesses, not luxury housing.

options.label: C
options.text: Civilian counts were zero because only Fighting Age men existed.
options.rationale: Civilian death range is explicitly 6-13 million on top of military losses.

options.label: D
options.text: Only through peaceful emigration away from Europe.
options.rationale: Civilian deaths were engineered and genocidal, not peaceful relocation.

questions.hint: 6-13 million civilians — hunger, disease, genocide.

questions.question: What were so-called Lunatic Asylums actually used for after the reset?

options.label: A
options.text: As Orphan Train depots with no locked wards, where cloned children waited to be sent to new cities.
options.rationale: Orphan Trains distributed clones; asylums locked away memory-bearing survivors.

options.label: B
options.text: As free universities teaching flat-plane cosmology and old-world history to the cloned orphans.
options.rationale: They suppressed witness testimony; they did not teach true cosmology publicly.

options.label: C
options.text: As Big Pharma factories synthesizing the first antibiotics, with no patients housed on site.
options.rationale: Big Pharma rose on erasing herbal knowledge; asylums were containment for witnesses.

options.label: D
options.text: As 5,000-bed facilities to imprison traumatized survivors who witnessed the reset first-hand, segregated from the new reprogrammed population.
options.rationale: Lunatic Asylums were repurposed 5,000-bed facilities imprisoning traumatized first-hand witnesses so their truths could not reach the new population.

questions.hint: 5,000-bed prisons for traumatized reset witnesses.

questions.question: What first-hand horrors had many imprisoned "lunatics" actually witnessed?

options.label: A
options.text: Families raped and flayed alive by reptilians and child-killing extraterrestrial species.
options.rationale: Those labeled lunatics were traumatized witnesses who had seen families raped and flayed alive by reptilians and child-killing extraterrestrial species.

options.label: B
options.text: Nothing — they invented stories to get free housing.
options.rationale: Imprisonment protected the new society from contamination by real witness truth.

options.label: C
options.text: Only mild fog over the trenches with no parasitic involvement.
options.rationale: Their trauma traces to open reset depravity involving reptilians and ET child-killers.

options.label: D
options.text: Peaceful stem-cell clinics under every Allied capital.
options.rationale: D.U.M.B.S. cloning served repopulation; the asylum population carried massacre memories.

questions.hint: Reptilian and ET atrocities — not imaginary illness.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Big Pharma” refers to the negative entities and overseers responsible for orchestrating the reset and the subsequent world war to secure their physical and mental control over humanity.

options.text: True

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Parasites”, not “Big Pharma”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Big Pharma”.

questions.question: How often do planetary resets occur in this framework, and what harvest do they serve?

options.label: A
options.text: Roughly every century, timed to the great wars so the harvest of soldiers can be hidden among the battle deaths.
options.rationale: The cycle is roughly millennial, tied to harvest and repopulation — not weekly parades.

options.label: B
options.text: Roughly every 10,000 years, when the Projection Dome needs rebuilding and a fresh supply of Loosh is required.
options.rationale: WW1 was the sanitization phase of one cycle inside a repeating reset pattern.

options.label: C
options.text: Roughly every fifty years, with each reset clearing a single continent to supply the Moon station's reserves.
options.rationale: Adrenochrome harvest from children is central to the reset motive.

options.label: D
options.text: Roughly every thousand years, facilitating the mass harvesting of Adrenochrome from children.
options.rationale: Planetary resets occur roughly every thousand years to facilitate mass harvesting of Adrenochrome from children.

questions.hint: About every thousand years; Adrenochrome from children.

options.label: D
options.text: By waiting for natural birth rates after 1950 alone.
options.rationale: Cloning in D.U.M.B.S. and Orphan Trains were the deliberate repopulation tools of that cycle.

questions.hint: D.U.M.B.S., stem cells, clones.

options.label: A

options.rationale: It removed those elders; it did not restore them.

options.label: B
options.text: It only redrew national borders and maps, without touching population memory or knowledge.
options.rationale: Memory and knowledge transmission were the primary targets of the cull.

options.label: C
options.text: It was the final sanitization phase, ensuring cloned orphans inherited a world with no mentors, teachers, or elders who held factual past knowledge.
options.rationale: WW1 was the final sanitization phase of the reset cycle, guaranteeing cloned orphans a world devoid of mentors, teachers, or elders with factual past knowledge.

options.text: It canceled all future thousand-year reset cycles and ended the control matrix for good.

questions.hint: Final sanitization — no elders left for clones.

options.label: A
options.text: A return to folk medicine in the countryside, while the cities turned to the new pharmacies for their care.
options.rationale: Synthetics replaced natural knowledge as the dependency system.

options.label: B

options.rationale: Old-world natural healing links were severed, not officially restored.

options.label: C
options.text: A global ban on herbal remedies, enforced by the Allied powers as part of the peace treaties of 1919.
options.rationale: Witnesses were segregated; medical control shifted to the synthetic industry.

options.label: D
options.text: The foundation for Big Pharma and a population perpetually sick and reliant on chemical medications.
options.rationale: Erasing those with herbal expertise established Big Pharma and locked the new population into sickness and chemical dependency.

questions.hint: Big Pharma foundation; chemical dependency.

options.rationale: Mass death of old-world cosmology holders allowed fake scientific paradigms and falsified historical timelines to be installed without organized intellectual resistance.

options.rationale: The culling completed installation of the current control matrix and locked repopulated society into profound generational ignorance.
